metadata.short_desc: Read and send native QQ faces naturally
metadata.desc: Provides inbound face understanding, inline-marker sending, dynamic catalogs, and animated-sticker splitting for OneBot QQ endpoints.

enable_inbound.hint: Annotates Face components as [QQ face:name] in their original positions. Annotations apply only to model-visible text while the actual message chain stays intact.

platform_overrides.description: Platform instance overrides as a JSON object
platform_overrides.hint: Keys are platform instance IDs shown by /face status; values are auto, enabled, or disabled, for example {"qq-main": "enabled"}. This workflow handles OneBot QQ platform instances.

face_aliases.description: Custom face aliases as a JSON object
face_aliases.hint: Keys are aliases; values are canonical catalog names or numeric IDs, for example {"grin": "smirk"}.

prompt_face_names.hint: Enter names or aliases from the active catalog.
